title: American Airlines brings grab-and-go lounge to New York's JFK
title_zh: 美国航空为纽约肯尼迪机场提供即取即走休息室
text: American Airlines is opening a grab-and-go lounge at New York's JFK
zh: 美国航空将在纽约肯尼迪国际机场开设外带休息室

title: Social Security gender gap means women receive about $4,800 less in annual benefits. What to know before claiming
title_zh: 社会保障性别差距意味着女性每年领取的福利少约 4,800 美元。索赔前需要了解什么
text: Women tend to earn less and spend more time outside of the work force, which may reduce their Social Security benefits. Here's what to consider before claiming.
zh: 女性的收入往往较低，并且在工作之外的时间较多，这可能会减少她们的社会保障福利。以下是索赔之前需要考虑的事项。

title: Wall Street says sell Goldman, buy Capital One. Here's where we stand
title_zh: 华尔街说卖掉高盛，买第一资本。这就是我们的立场
text: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.
zh: 每个工作日，投资俱乐部都会发布最后冲刺；下午交易最后一小时的可行更新。

title: Waymo and Uber end robotaxi pilot in Phoenix
title_zh: Waymo 和 Uber 终止凤凰城机器人出租车试点
text: The Waymo self-driving cars deployed in Phoenix for the Uber pilot will remain in use and make autonomous deliveries with DoorDash.
zh: 在凤凰城为 Uber 试点部署的 Waymo 自动驾驶汽车将继续使用，并与 DoorDash 一起进行自动送货。

title: Treasury Secretary Bessent backs rate cuts but says he understands if the Fed wants to wait
title_zh: 财政部长贝森特支持降息，但表示他理解美联储是否愿意等待
text: Bessent has previously said the Fed should hasten cutting interest rates, calling reductions "the only ingredient missing" for stronger economic growth.
zh: 贝森特此前曾表示，美联储应加快降息，称降息是经济增长强劲的“唯一缺失的因素”。

title: Warren Buffett says he sold Apple too soon and would buy more of it, though not in this market
title_zh: 沃伦·巴菲特表示，他太早卖掉了苹果公司，并将购买更多苹果公司，尽管不是在这个市场
text: Apple remains Berkshire Hathaway's largest holding even after the conglomerate trimmed its stake at the end of last year.
zh: 即使伯克希尔哈撒韦公司去年底减持了其股份，苹果公司仍然是伯克希尔哈撒韦公司最大的持股公司。

title: How to stay healthy in a heat wave — and medicines that put you at risk for heat exhaustion
title_zh: 如何在热浪中保持健康——以及使您面临热衰竭风险的药物
text: Heatstroke can affect anyone, but people who take certain medications or have certain health conditions are at higher risk.
zh: 中暑可能影响任何人，但服用某些药物或患有某些健康状况的人面临更高的风险。

title: Oil posts largest quarterly price drop in 6 years as historic supply crunch eases
title_zh: 随着历史性供应紧缩的缓解，石油价格录得六年来最大季度跌幅
text: Workarounds for the Strait of Hormuz chokepoint and a drop in crude imports to China helped ease the impact of lost Persian Gulf oil.
zh: 霍尔木兹海峡咽喉要道的解决办法和中国原油进口的减少有助于缓解波斯湾石油损失的影响。

title: U.S. airline stocks are soaring as cheaper jet fuel and insatiable demand set up a summer boom
title_zh: 由于廉价航空燃油和无法满足的需求引发夏季繁荣，美国航空公司股票飙升
text: Delta, United shares fly toward fresh records as the airline sector has rallied 20% in June.
zh: 达美航空和联合航空的股价在 6 月份上涨了 20%，创下新高。

title: The chip rally has a dark side — and a rare market risk is at its highest level since 2015
title_zh: 芯片涨势也有阴暗面——罕见的市场风险达到 2015 年以来的最高水平
text: A cavernous spread between stock and index volatility leaves semiconductor leaders, including AMD and Micron, vulnerable.
zh: 股票和指数波动之间的巨大差距使包括 AMD 和美光在内的半导体领军企业变得脆弱。

title: Millions of Americans can get Medicare to cover GLP-1s for weight loss starting this week. Here’s how much it costs.
title_zh: 从本周开始，数百万美国人可以获得医疗保险来承保 GLP-1 减肥药物。这是它的费用。
text: Until this week, Medicare only covered GLP-1 drugs for conditions like Type 2 diabetes, sleep apnea, and stroke or heart-attack risk.
zh: 直到本周，医疗保险仅承保治疗 2 型糖尿病、睡眠呼吸暂停以及中风或心脏病风险等疾病的 GLP-1 药物。

title: I want to pay off $20,000 of credit-card debt in one year. Should I hire someone to negotiate my bill?
title_zh: 我想在一年内还清 20,000 美元的信用卡债务。我应该雇人来协商我的账单吗？
text: “I used to have $60,000 and I’ve been able to knock it down.”
zh: “我以前有 6 万美元，现在我已经能把它花光了。”

title: China’s Manufacturing Activity Expands, Buoyed by Exports - WSJ
title_zh: 出口带动中国制造业活动扩张 - 华尔街日报
text: China’s Manufacturing Activity Expands, Buoyed by Exports WSJ
zh: 受出口提振，中国制造业活动扩张 华尔街日报

title: China Loses Out on AI Boom as Stocks Trail by Most Since ‘01 - Bloomberg.com
title_zh: 中国在人工智能热潮中失利，股市跌幅自 01 年以来最大跌幅 - Bloomberg.com
text: China Loses Out on AI Boom as Stocks Trail by Most Since ‘01 Bloomberg.com
zh: 中国在人工智能繁荣中失利，股市自 01 年以来跌幅最大 Bloomberg.com

title: Asia stocks rise on upbeat China PMI; tech spurs bumper quarter - Investing.com
title_zh: 亚洲股市因中国 PMI 乐观而上涨；科技推动季度繁荣 - Investing.com
text: Asia stocks rise on upbeat China PMI; tech spurs bumper quarter Investing.com
zh: 亚洲股市因中国 PMI 乐观而上涨；科技推动季度繁荣 Investing.com

title: Major egg producers settle price inflation probe for $3.3 million
title_zh: 主要鸡蛋生产商以 330 万美元和解价格通胀调查
text: Cal-Maine Foods, Versova and Hickman's Egg Ranch agreed to settle allegations of price manipulation by the Justice Department and 17 states.
zh: Cal-Maine Foods、Versova 和 Hickman's Egg Ranch 同意就司法部和 17 个州的价格操纵指控达成和解。

title: Private equity in youth sports draws bipartisan scrutiny in Congress
title_zh: 青年体育领域的私募股权在国会受到两党审查
text: Democratic and Republican Congress members expressed alarm at the trend of private equity investment in youth sports.
zh: 民主党和共和党国会议员对私募股权投资青少年体育的趋势表示担忧。

title: FDA lets Philip Morris market Zyn nicotine pouches as less harmful than cigarettes
title_zh: FDA 允许菲利普莫里斯公司销售 Zyn 尼古丁袋，其危害比香烟低
text: The Trump administration has expanded access to nicotine products despite concerns from public health critics about youth use and addiction.
zh: 尽管公共卫生批评者对青少年使用尼古丁和成瘾表示担忧，但特朗普政府还是扩大了尼古丁产品的获取范围。

title: Blue Origin pivots to redesigned launchpad after explosion in push to fly by end of 2026
title_zh: 蓝色起源在 2026 年底前推动飞行取得爆炸性进展后，转向重新设计发射台
text: Blue Origin won't be "rebuilding the same pad," and will instead adopt a configuration that was in development for a larger variant of its New Glenn rocket.
zh: 蓝色起源不会“重建相同的发射台”，而是采用为其新格伦火箭的更大型号开发的配置。

title: Nike is set to report earnings after the bell. Here's what to expect
title_zh: 耐克将于盘后公布财报。这是值得期待的
text: Nike is expected to report another quarter of declining sales as the sneaker giant struggles to regain strength under its turnaround strategy.
zh: 耐克预计将报告另一个季度的销售额下降，因为这家运动鞋巨头在其扭亏为盈战略下努力恢复实力。

title: Cramer says this aerospace stock is significantly undervalued, sees 35% upside
title_zh: 克莱默表示，这只航空航天股被严重低估，预计上涨 35%
text: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.
zh: 投资俱乐部在每个工作日上午 10:20（东部时间）举行“晨会”。

title: Supreme Court rulings on Fed, FTC: What they mean for consumers
title_zh: 最高法院对美联储和联邦贸易委员会的裁决：它们对消费者意味着什么
text: The Supreme Court issued a pair of highly anticipated rulings on Monday that have far-reaching implications for household finances.
zh: 最高法院周一发布了两项备受期待的裁决，对家庭财务产生深远影响。

title: Small cap-focused Russell 2000 becomes first U.S. benchmark to enter correction territory
title_zh: 以小盘股为主的罗素 2000 指数成为首个进入修正区间的美国基准指数
text: Small caps are especially sensitive to changes in oil prices and a slowdown in the economic cycle.
zh: 小盘股对油价变化和经济周期放缓尤其敏感。

title: Fed still expects to cut rates once this year despite spiking oil prices
title_zh: 尽管油价飙升，美联储仍预计今年降息一次
text: The central bank's so-called dot plot showed a median estimate of 3.4% for the federal funds rate, the same as at the end of last year.
zh: 央行所谓的点阵图显示，联邦基金利率的中值为3.4%，与去年年底相同。

title: Amazon is laying out $1 billion to follow Palantir’s AI playbook
title_zh: 亚马逊将斥资 10 亿美元追随 Palantir 的 AI 策略
text: Packages aren’t the only thing Amazon.com is delivering: The company is now sending engineers directly to clients in order to bolster artificial-intelligence adoption.
zh: 包裹并不是亚马逊提供的唯一东西：该公司现在直接向客户派遣工程师，以促进人工智能的采用。

title: Your aging parent has a new romance. Here’s how to protect your inheritance — without looking greedy.
title_zh: 你年迈的父母有了新的恋情。以下是如何保护你的遗产——但又不显得贪婪。
text: Before your single mom or dad remarries, talk with them about estate-planning issues.
zh: 在你的单亲妈妈或爸爸再婚之前，与他们讨论遗产规划问题。

title: Record beef imports are flooding the U.S. — so why is your Fourth of July BBQ so expensive?
title_zh: 创纪录的牛肉进口量正在涌入美国——那么为什么你们的国庆节烧烤这么贵呢？
text: Beef prices are sizzling and Washington’s recipe for high costs — import more meat — only grills your wallet.
zh: 牛肉价格飞涨，而华盛顿的高成本秘诀——进口更多肉类——只会让你的钱包更加煎熬。

title: Gold is on the verge of a ‘death cross’ that could surprisingly foreshadow gains
title_zh: 黄金正处于“死亡十字”的边缘，这可能令人惊讶地预示着上涨
text: Here’s what 45 years of data on death crosses in gold can tell us about the path ahead.
zh: 以下是 45 年黄金死亡交叉数据可以告诉我们的未来之路。

title: Sandisk’s stock could follow record-breaking quarter with another big jump, analysts say
title_zh: 分析师表示，闪迪的股价可能会在创纪录的季度之后再次大幅上涨
text: As investors get more discerning in separating potential artificial-intelligence winners from losers, memory stocks have become a standout trade.
zh: 随着投资者在区分潜在的人工智能赢家和输家方面变得更加敏锐，内存股已成为一项出色的交易。

title: ‘She is retired’: Do I dip into my 401(k) to pay my mother’s $30,000 credit-card debt?
title_zh: “她退休了”：我是否需要动用 401(k) 来偿还我母亲 30,000 美元的信用卡债务？
text: “I want her to live on her Social Security instead of using it to pay off her credit-card debt.”
zh: “我希望她靠社会保障生活，而不是用它来偿还信用卡债务。”

title: Supreme Court upholds birthright citizenship, blocks Trump order
title_zh: 最高法院维持出生公民权，阻止特朗普命令
text: President Donald Trump attended oral arguments in the case, underscoring his staunch opposition to granting automatic citizenship to many immigrants' babies.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统出席了此案的口头辩论，强调他坚决反对向许多移民婴儿自动授予公民身份。

title: AWS puts $1 billion into new AI unit to embed engineers with customers, joining growing wave
title_zh: AWS 向新的人工智能部门投入 10 亿美元，让工程师与客户融为一体，加入不断增长的浪潮
text: AWS FDEs will look to leave behind self-sufficient teams with new AI solutions and capabilities in a matter of weeks, the company said.
zh: 该公司表示，AWS FDE 将在几周内留下拥有新的人工智能解决方案和功能的自给自足的团队。

title: Cleveland Fed President Hammack sees AI fueling inflation, says rate hikes may be necessary
title_zh: 克利夫兰联储主席哈马克认为人工智能助长通胀，称可能有必要加息
text: "We've got inflation that's too high, and it's been too high for the past five years," Beth Hammack told CNBC's Sara Eisen.
zh: 贝丝·哈马克 (Beth Hammack) 告诉 CNBC 的萨拉·艾森 (Sara Eisen)：“我们的通货膨胀率太高了，过去五年一直太高。”

title: Supreme Court strikes down limits on political parties' campaign spending, in win for GOP
title_zh: 最高法院取消对政党竞选支出的限制，共和党获胜
text: President Donald Trump took a victory lap after the ruling, writing on Truth Social that it was "A BIG WIN FOR REPUBLICANS."
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在裁决后庆祝胜利，并在《Truth Social》上写道，这是“共和党人的一大胜利”。

title: Trump administration expands list of graduate degrees subject to higher borrowing limits
title_zh: 特朗普政府扩大了受更高借款限额限制的研究生学位名单
text: Many graduate students will be subject to higher federal student loan caps than previously expected, after a court ruling last week. Here's what to know.
zh: 法院上周做出裁决后，许多研究生将面临比之前预期更高的联邦学生贷款上限。以下是需要了解的内容。

title: GOP Rep. Tom Kean says depression diagnosis caused months-long absence from Congress
title_zh: 共和党众议员汤姆·基恩表示，抑郁症诊断导致他缺席国会数月
text: New Jersey Rep. Tom Kean said he was diagnosed with depression, explaining a months-long absence from Congress in a competitive district in the midterm elections.
zh: 新泽西州众议员汤姆·基恩 (Tom Kean) 表示，他被诊断出患有抑郁症，并解释了他在中期选举竞争激烈的选区缺席国会数月的原因。

title: AeroVironment skyrockets 15% as dronemaker capitalizes on defense spending surge
title_zh: 无人机制造商利用国防支出激增，AeroVironment 飙升 15%
text: AeroVironment is benefiting from U.S. plans to modernize the U.S. military and secure space.
zh: AeroVironment 正受益于美国的军事现代化和太空安全计划。

title: We're selling some shares of a parabolic mover, more than tripling our money
title_zh: 我们正在出售抛物线移动者的一些股票，这使我们的资金增加了三倍多
text: This is the 8th best stock in the S&P 500 year to date.
zh: 这是今年迄今为止标准普尔 500 指数中排名第八的最佳股票。

title: Ex-Google recruiter: The No. 1 resume 'red flag' that makes hiring managers stop reading—and how to fix it
title_zh: 前谷歌招聘人员：导致招聘经理停止阅读的排名第一的简历“危险信号”以及如何解决这个问题
text: Former Google recruiter Farah Sharghi reveals the biggest mistake job seekers make with their resumes.
zh: 前谷歌招聘人员法拉·沙吉 (Farah Sharghi) 揭露了求职者在简历中犯的最大错误。

title: Berkshire shares trade lower even after Abel scores good marks at meeting, earnings jump
title_zh: 即使阿贝尔在会议上取得好成绩、盈利大幅增长，伯克希尔股价仍走低
text: Many in the investment community were reassured by Abel's firm grasp over Berkshire's sprawling enterprise.
zh: 阿贝尔对伯克希尔庞大企业的坚定控制让投资界的许多人感到放心。

title: Even Wall Street bulls are worried about a stock-market pullback after dazzling second quarter
title_zh: 就连华尔街多头也担心股市在第二季度表现耀眼后回调
text: The first half of 2026 is coming to a close on Tuesday, and with it, another rollicking stretch for the U.S. equity market.
zh: 周二，2026 年上半年即将结束，美国股市也将迎来又一个热闹的时期。

title: Job openings rise to 2-year high, but good luck actually getting one
title_zh: 职位空缺升至两年高位，但祝你好运
text: A prolonged decline in job openings in the U.S. appears to be over, but it doesn’t mean businesses are ready to do lots of hiring or make it easier for people to find work.
zh: 美国职位空缺的长期下降似乎已经结束，但这并不意味着企业已准备好进行大量招聘或让人们更容易找到工作。

title: Alphabet’s stock slump is a ‘tactical buying opportunity,’ according to one analyst
title_zh: 一位分析师表示，Alphabet 的股价暴跌是一个“战术性买入机会”
text: Investors are overlooking the potential of Alphabet’s custom-chip business as the company plans to expand its data-center capacity going into 2028, according to Morgan Stanley.
zh: 摩根士丹利表示，投资者忽视了 Alphabet 定制芯片业务的潜力，因为该公司计划在 2028 年扩大其数据中心容量。

title: Insurers shifted roof-replacement costs onto homeowners thanks to a new federal rule — just in time for hail and hurricane season
title_zh: 由于一项新的联邦规定，保险公司将屋顶更换费用转嫁给房主——正好赶上冰雹和飓风季节
text: Those who find extensive damage to their roofs might be stuck between two options: File an insurance claim, which could trigger a premium increase, or cough up the cash for the necessary repairs or replacement.
zh: 那些发现屋顶严重损坏的人可能会陷入两种选择：提出保险索赔，这可能会导致保费增加，或者支付现金进行必要的维修或更换。

title: What’s a ‘soft’ off day? How to take one without getting in trouble at work.
title_zh: 什么是“软”休息日？如何在工作中不遇到麻烦的情况下服用它。
text: Plus: Why you should consider taking a “life admin” day.
zh: 另外：为什么你应该考虑参加“生活管理”日。

title: Small-cap stocks enjoy their best first half in 35 years. Here's what's driving it
title_zh: 小盘股上半年表现 35 年来最好。这就是推动它的因素
text: The advance marks a sharp turnaround after years of underperformance versus large-cap peers.
zh: 此次上涨标志着多年来与大盘股相比表现不佳之后的急剧转变。

title: White House AI crackdown opens door for Chinese model makers to close gap
title_zh: 白宫对人工智能的打击为中国模型制造商缩小差距打开了大门
text: The Trump administration's crackdown on Anthropic's leading artificial intelligence models is looking like a gift to China.
zh: 特朗普政府对 Anthropic 领先的人工智能模型的打击看起来像是送给中国的一份礼物。

title: Trump's defense budget, depleted war machine, spark state battle for business and jobs
title_zh: 特朗普的国防预算、耗尽的战争机器引发了各州的商业和就业之战
text: Trump's huge defense budget request and a race to replenish weapons stocks while building hypersonic missiles lead to war between U.S. states for jobs.
zh: 特朗普巨额国防预算要求以及在制造高超音速导弹的同时补充武器库存的竞赛导致了美国各州之间的就业战争。

title: Comcast's NBCUniversal spinoff raises hope for more deals. There may not be good options
title_zh: 康卡斯特 (Comcast) 的 NBC环球 (NBCUniversal) 分拆项目引发了更多交易的希望。可能没有好的选择
text: Comcast plans to separate its cable and media divisions over the next year. This could set each company up for M&A, but there might not be any good options.
zh: 康卡斯特计划在明年将其有线电视和媒体部门分开。这可能会让每家公司都做好并购的准备，但可能没有什么好的选择。

title: Eli Lilly, Regeneron among first companies selected for FDA initiative to speed review of new manufacturing facilities
title_zh: 礼来 (Eli Lilly) 和再生元 (Regeneron) 是首批入选 FDA 计划的公司之一，以加快对新生产设施的审查
text: Eli Lilly and Regeneron are among the first seven companies the FDA has selected for its PreCheck Pilot Program, CNBC has learned.
zh: 据 CNBC 获悉，礼来公司 (Eli Lilly) 和再生元 (Regeneron) 是 FDA 首批选定的七家公司之一，参与其 PreCheck 试点计划。

title: Micron's monster post-earnings rally is almost gone. Traders divided on where it goes next
title_zh: 美光科技公布财报后的强劲反弹几乎已经消失。交易员对下一步走向存在分歧
text: The maker of memory chips slid to start the week, marking an about-face from its post-earnings surge.
zh: 这家存储芯片制造商本周开盘下滑，标志着其盈利后飙升的局面发生了转变。

title: ‘We are more likely to be living in poverty’: Social Security is a lifeline for women, so why are we ignored?
title_zh: “我们更有可能生活在贫困之中”：社会保障是女性的生命线，为何我们却被忽视？
text: “We are more likely to live longer, to live alone and to be caregivers.”
zh: “我们更有可能活得更久，独自生活并成为照顾者。”

title_zh: 争吵、痛苦和疏远：老年护理如何导致兄弟姐妹分裂

title: ‘She wants him gone’: My friend took in a homeless man as a caretaker. After 10 years, how can she evict him?
title_zh: “她希望他离开”：我的朋友收留了一名无家可归的人作为看护人。十年了，她怎么能赶走他？
text: “He lived rent-free, helping her with health-related issues and other tasks.”
zh: “他免租居住，帮助她解决与健康相关的问题和其他任务。”

title: A 23% plunge in personal wealth leaves this country trailing its global peers
title_zh: 个人财富暴跌 23%，使该国落后于全球其他国家

zh: 这个国家的人均财富迅速下降——与其他发达市场相比，情况看起来并不好。

zh: 这位亿万富翁投资者表示，未来 6 到 12 个月霍尔木兹海峡的长期封锁将意味着不可避免的经济衰退。

title: The big surprise for the year’s second half could be the AI trade powering higher. Why it wouldn’t take much.

zh: 佩雷斯·希尔顿 (Perez Hilton) 在经历了几次健康恐慌后，“上帝告诉他”要离开内华达州，他以 425 万美元的价格出售了他在拉斯维加斯的房屋，并搬到了迈阿密。
